title: Enchanted Writing

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered magical scholar silhouette: oversized wide-brim pointed witch hat, structured dark coat with split tails over a pleated plaid mini skirt with lace-trimmed shorts, voluminous sleeves and cape-like back panels creating a dramatic, elegant A-line volumes.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A grand pointed witch hat featuring a wide folded brim with a starry navy underside, wrapped in an ornate purple ribbon with a gilded feather quill and brass buckles.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Fitted dark corset-style bodice worn under a tailored long coat, featuring sheer organza collars, gold embroidery, and ornate celestial motifs. Sleeves are voluminous, gathered at the shoulder with flared cuffs trimmed in lace, revealing detached white pleated chiffon sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A dark tailcoat-style split robe with gold-framed edges and lapel chains, worn over a golden-brown plaid pleated mini skirt with a ruffled white petticoat hem and lace-trimmed tap shorts. Completed with sheer dark thigh-high stockings and sleek black heeled boots with silver buckles.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A floating enchanted quill pen, drifting starry ink motes, and phantom pages of glowing parchment that spiral around the wearer, alongside a celestial compass clasp and star-shaped brooches.
